# Quentin Dupard

>  Fractional product and marketing operator. Paid for ideas that make money:
>  positioning, pricing, activation and expansion revenue. Works with any
>  business that has a funnel and a price, worldwide.

Quentin is a fractional product and marketing operator, not an agency and not a
strategy consultancy. The work is finding revenue a business has already earned
but isn't collecting: usually trapped in how it is positioned, what it charges,
or the steps between someone showing interest and actually buying.

Previous projects include a health and wellness course business, an HR tech
SaaS platform he built himself, a bootstrapped local grocery business, the lead
acquisition side of a comparison platform, and app products end to end. These
are past engagements rather than sectors he specialises in; the point is that
the same levers kept working across businesses with little else in common.

His view: now that execution is cheap, the scarce thing is judgement about what
to build, who it's for, how to describe it, and what it should cost. Those are
creative decisions, and they're what he sells.

## What he works on

- **Positioning and messaging** — usually the cheapest fix and the biggest one
- **Pricing and packaging** — the fastest revenue lever in software, and the one teams touch least
- **Activation** — closing the gap between signup and the moment the product works
- **Expansion revenue** — building a business that grows with its customers instead of refilling a leaking bucket
- **Product strategy** — what to build and, harder, what to kill

## Specialist knowledge

Deep familiarity with the global employment, EOR and HR-tech market from 150+
provider teardowns — pricing models, entity structures, compliance depth and
margin architecture. This is a specialism he brings when a client is in that
market, not his general offering.

## Engagements

- **Espresso** — a 90-minute teardown of your business, plus a written follow-up
- **Sprint** — two weeks embedded, moving one lever (usually pricing or activation)
- **Operator** — ongoing fractional product and marketing, three-month minimum

## Research

Long-form working notes. Free to read, no gate.

- [All research](https://quentindupard.com/research/)
- [Influence by Robert Cialdini: which of the six still work on a machine](https://quentindupard.com/research/influence-robert-cialdini/): book review of the six principles of persuasion, with product and marketing findings, and why only social proof and authority reach a search or answer engine
- [Hooked by Nir Eyal: what survives when you are not a social app](https://quentindupard.com/research/hooked-nir-eyal/): book review of the Hook Model (trigger, action, variable reward, investment), with the product and marketing findings separated, and what the model implies for SEO and generative engine optimisation

## Languages

Every page exists in English, French and Spanish at the same path, prefixed
with the language code. The English URL is the x-default.

- English: https://quentindupard.com/
- Français: https://quentindupard.com/fr/
- Español: https://quentindupard.com/es/

The content is the same in all three; the translations are not summaries.

## Building, not only advising

Quentin builds as well as advises. He has shipped whole products end to end:
ecommerce, newsletters and content engines, internal tooling, and operations
automation. Where the answer to a revenue problem is something that does not
exist yet, he builds it rather than writing a specification for someone else.
The same applies to marketing strategy, which he takes whole rather than in
pieces. This is not limited to one industry.
